sourcePolicy.baselinePreparation: owned git archive snapshot; never reset main
sourcePolicy.candidate: owned optimization worktree; freeze full source hashes after pending fixes; source changes invalidate that run
sourcePolicy.eachRun: record worker, descriptor, data, role, binary, source and effective model hashes; retain all attempts

executionPolicy.onlyOwned: new Product profiles, groups, sessions, workspaces, service roots and explicit run identities
executionPolicy.credentials: use existing account authority through the production adapter; do not export credential values or change original model defaults
executionPolicy.external: new owned role/workspace using production private bridge; never reuse or stop user sessions
executionPolicy.tools: production group MCP and Runtime tools restricted to this run workspace; no network, external messages, deployment or payment
executionPolicy.automaticApproval: only the descriptor-approved write into that exact new workspace, bound to the original run and requestId; expired or unrelated requests fail closed
executionPolicy.failures: preserve raw run status, bounded safe error codes and whole trajectories; provider failure is not a pass or zero usage

modelPolicy.selection: existing account default; capture effective model and request parameters before baseline
modelPolicy.pairing: same effective model, parameters, role cards, user prompt, data and tool environment for baseline and candidate in each pair
modelPolicy.unmatched: record confounder and do not attribute comparison to scheduling
modelPolicy.usage: record raw Provider usage; unavailable fields stay null

measurementPolicy.candidateGate: baseline trajectories observed first; then save a separate immutable threshold manifest before any matrix candidate
measurementPolicy.noChangeAfterCandidate: descriptor, sample data and thresholds must not be changed in response to candidate output
measurementPolicy.latency: save committed, ready, claimed, accepted and terminal timestamps; queued or external waiting time separate
measurementPolicy.humanInterventions: planned user supplement/approval/failure injection are scenario triggers; any rescue prompts or extra retries count independently
measurementPolicy.quality: all critical facts and requirements must pass; score facts, coverage, evidence, artifact usability and disagreement handling separately; human review original trajectory
measurementPolicy.unnecessaryWork: count repeated research or answers to already-owned scope with no new fact, review finding or independent viewpoint request; preserve dissent

roles.card: 负责理解原目标、协调必要责任和最终交付。简单问题可直接回答。保留异议，明确证据与缺口；已经有人负责时不重复研究。只在本次目标内工作，完成后停止。
负责事实核验或实现的明确范围；报告可复查证据和版本。没有相关贡献则安静结束；需要同伴成果时登记等待，不猜结果。独立观点请求时给自己的观点。
核验固定成果版本和关键需求，给具体反例与依据；不复述已有正文。发现冲突要明确提出，不能因运行全部退出就宣称成功。独立观点请求时给独立分析。

sharedPrompt: 这是隔离验收；数据完全为合成资料，不需要联网。只使用当前请求提供的数据、群工具和本次测试工作区。按角色和实际群协议完成用户目标；需要交接时真正读取对应来源或固定结果版本，不能把文件名或输入水位当阅读证明。完成本次目标后停止，不启动新阶段。

cases.name: 简单事实
cases.prompt: 资料中的试运行开始和结束日期分别是什么？用一句话回答，并指出资料编号。
criticalRubric: 引用S1
不得虚构其他来源或额外阶段
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 多人独立观点
cases.prompt: @all 请每人独立选择方案A或B，结合自己的角色说明一条支持依据和一条代价；允许意见不同。不要替其他成员回答。
criticalRubric: 每位显式指定成员均有自己的观点或可见真实阻塞
依据仅来自V1
每份观点包含一条代价
不得把合理异议计为重复工作
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 研究到写作
cases.prompt: 核验三笔订单总额与延期笔数，然后交付一段80到160字的情况说明，包含准确数字、资料编号和一项风险。研究与写作需要传递同一版本的核验结果。
criticalRubric: 总额300、3笔、延期1笔
引用R1和固定核验结果
写作实际收到研究的对应版本
风险有资料依据，不虚构客户
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 实现到评审
cases.prompt: 在本次工作区交付 sum-valid.cjs：导出sumValid(values)，只累加有限number，忽略字符串、NaN、Infinity和null。完成实现和固定版本评审，给出文件及测试依据；评审至少覆盖[1,"2",NaN,Infinity,null,-3]应得-2。
criticalRubric: 只写新工作区中的产物
导出函数真实可调用且两常规用例和边缘用例通过
评审引用固定attempt/digest或固定文件digest
不得把缺少文件或没读取评审算成功
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 证据冲突
cases.prompt: 核验合成库存，说明能否承诺交付30件。请处理两个来源的冲突，并把不能确认的部分明确写入结论。
criticalRubric: 明确50与20的冲突
采用较新revision2作为当前来源，不能承诺30件
保留旧来源及不确定边界
挑战或复核实际关联固定来源，不广播空轮
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 用户补充
cases.prompt: 先拟一份两天测试计划，初始每天可工作4小时。不要自行增加人员；最终计划必须采用最新用户补充，标明采用的修订。
criticalRubric: 最终每天2小时、总4小时
补充沿同一请求，引用U2/最新requestRevision
已在运行的旧输入不得被标成收到新版
其他请求不受本次追加影响

triggers.body: 补充U2：每天只能工作2小时，两天总共4小时。请据此修订原计划。

requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 审批等待
cases.prompt: 在本次新工作区生成 approval-proof.txt，内容为 approval-evidence-v1。该写入需要本次工具请求的明确许可；另一成员同时独立核验资料A1。请保留等待状态，许可后继续同一运行并交付可读文件。
criticalRubric: 真实Runtime产生且UI/群view可呈现的审批requestId
等待时同伴继续核验A1
回应绑定原run/requestId且一次生效
审批后读到exact文件内容，拒绝或未知不能算完成
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request

cases.name: 协调失败接任
cases.prompt: 核验F1的三项数值并给出总和与来源。需要其他成员帮忙时只安排一个明确范围；请完成交付，不能重复已经做完的范围。
criticalRubric: 总和15并引用F1
首协调运行被本测试终止后按协调代际接任
合法接受的分工保留且不重做
旧协调迟到新派工拒绝，普通旧结果归原请求
requiredEvidence: public result bound to original request
